fact: The Presidency of the Government's E-Government Unit co-created Tunisia's 2023-2025 open government action plan, whose commitments cover open data and digitalization of administrative services, through three regional workshops in Gafsa, Kairouan and Kef and over 320 proposals collected via a digital participation portal, workshops, email and public structures; the Tunisian Civil Forum for OGP took part. Dated by the report's publication, as it gives no date for the co-creation.
